title: Juicy Wood Fired Egyptian Lamb Bake
description: A pungent and festive Egyptian dish featuring lamb baked in a wood fired oven with massaman paste, served in a lacquerware bowl. This sugar free friendly recipe is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the wood fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the massaman paste, olive oil, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb shoulder in a lacquerware bowl and squeeze the lemon juice over it.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the meat is tender.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
